name: Vanguard Princess Mobile (PC Port)
detailed_description:
KICKSTARTER

Support Vanguard Princess Mobile on Kickstarter!

Get ready to bring Vanguard Princess to mobile! The acclaimed 2D all-female fighting game is coming to Android (with iOS planned), featuring smooth touch controls, controller support, online multiplayer, and enhanced content.

Why Back the Kickstarter?

🔥 Mobile Gameplay Optimized – Play with touch controls, game controllers, or arcade fight sticks.
🌍 Multiplayer Battles – Face players worldwide via Photon Unity Network 2 (PUN2), with Bluetooth support planned.
🎨 Classic + New Content – 10 fighters, new stages, music, and artwork crafted for mobile.
⚡ Smooth Online Play – Frame delay and rollback netcode for lag-free battles.
🧠 Advanced AI – Fuzzy Logic AI adapts to your playstyle for a dynamic challenge.

How You Can Help:

⭐ Spread the Word – Share with fighting game fans and friends!
📱 Stay Updated – Follow us for exclusive sneak peeks and campaign updates.
👊 Join the Fight – Your backing will make Vanguard Princess Mobile a reality!

Let’s bring the battle to mobile together—Back the Kickstarter today! 🚀


About the Game

Vanguard Princess Mobile (PC Port): Demo Edition

The Mobile Fighting Sensation—Now on PC!

Get ready to experience Vanguard Princess like never before! This PC port of the mobile version brings fast-paced 2D combat to your desktop, giving you a taste of the action before the full release.

What’s in the Demo?

- Story Mode (Sample): Play as two characters in an early chapter of the gripping story.

- Versus Mode: Battle AI or friends in intense one-on-one fights.

- Online Mode (Limited): Face off against up to 20 concurrent players in online matches via Photon servers.

Support the Kickstarter Campaign!

We’re bringing Vanguard Princess to mobile with refined gameplay, enhanced features, and more content—and you can help make it happen! By supporting our Kickstarter campaign, you’ll directly contribute to the game’s development and improvements.

Join the fight, back the project, and help shape the future of Vanguard Princess!

Why Play The Demo?

This demo is your chance to immerse yourself in the vibrant world of Vanguard Princess, with stunning anime-inspired visuals, fluid animations, and dynamic combat mechanics. Whether you're a newcomer or a seasoned fighting game fan, the demo is designed to give you a taste of the action before the full release.

Are You Ready to Fight?

The world of Vanguard Princess awaits—will you rise to the challenge?
